description: He wears a long navy blue wool-like kaftan with narrow gold-toned geometric borders along the open front, cuffs and hem. Brown fur-like trim lines the collar and cuffs. A cream long shirt with blue embroidery is visible inside the coat and at the neckline. A woven blue and gold sash wraps the waist, with a fringed end hanging down the front. Dark brown trousers tuck into tall worn brown leather boots with wrap-like fastening near the upper shafts. Full sleeves and layered opaque cloth cover the torso and legs. The fur trim is restrained rather than a large cloak. Exact materials cannot be confirmed.
